title: Zesty Flaky Norwegian Vegetables Pie
description: A charred and flaky Norwegian dish featuring shortcrust pastry and robata-grilled vegetables, perfect for a festive meal. This vegetarian-friendly pie is cooked to perfection on a comal.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the shortcrust pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced carrots, Brussels sprouts, and red onion with olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the vegetable mixture evenly over the center of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the vegetables to form a crust, pressing gently to seal.
Place the pie on a preheated comal and cook for 20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Rotate the pie 90 degrees and continue cooking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the crust is charred and flaky.
Remove the pie from the comal and let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
